g.text: There is no name catalog yet, so the sounds show as numbers.
Scanning reads all three kinds of name back from the unit --
presets, hyperpresets and midimaps -- one request per kind,
about three requests in total. Every one of those reads is
silent: nothing is selected, nothing plays, nothing is written
to the instrument, and the reading costs nothing audible on the
Morpheus. It takes a few seconds.
no names yet -- press r to read the unit, or build a catalog with tools/extract_catalog.py
